implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.SIZE = 15 and Board.__init__ creates a 15x15 grid (board.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Two players (Black and White) alternate turns, Black starts
implemented_requirements.evidence: GomokuGame.__init__ sets current_player = BLACK and play_move switches player after a legal move (game.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Place stones on empty intersections only
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.is_valid_move checks bounds and emptiness; Board.place_stone raises on occupied cells (board.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect win: five or more stones in a row horizontally, vertically, or diagonally
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.check_win iterates over four DIRECTIONS and counts consecutive stones, returning the player when count >= 5 (board.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Provide the exact winning line for UI highlighting
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.get_winning_line collects stones in both directions and returns the list (board.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect draw when board is full without a win
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.is_full checks every cell; GomokuGame.play_move sets game_over and winner=None when is_full() is true (game.py).
GomokuGame.undo_move removes the last stone, restores turn and clears win state (game.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Reset the game to a fresh state
implemented_requirements.evidence: GomokuGame.reset clears the board and resets all state variables (game.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Console UI for playing the game
implemented_requirements.evidence: ConsoleUI class parses input, displays board via Board.display(), and runs a game loop (console_ui.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Graphical UI with tkinter, falling back to console if unavailable
implemented_requirements.evidence: main.py tries to import tkinter and gui.GomokuGUI; on failure it falls back to ConsoleUI (main.py).

critical_issues: Two GUI modules (gomokugui.py and gui.py) exist; only gui.py is used. This duplication is harmless but may cause confusion.
Board.get_winning_line sorts the line coordinates, which may reorder the visual sequence of the winning stones; UI still highlights them but order is not preserved.
judge.summary: The submitted code implements a complete Gomoku game on a 15x15 board with alternating Black/White turns, win detection for five-in-a-row in all directions, draw detection, undo, reset, and both console and tkinter GUIs. All core requirements are satisfied and the program appears runnable, giving a passing verdict.
